name: Blueberry Hill by the Appalachian Trail
tagline: Blueberry Hill by the Appalachian Trail
description: Blueberry Hill by the Appalachian Trail is an agritourism farm in 47 Washington Mountain Road, WA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
